allow: PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://tawhitimedia.nz" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; Write-Output "STATUS: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; Write-Output "--- head content ---"; \($r.Content -split "`n" | Select-String -Pattern "viewport|icon|og:|description|title|script" | Select-Object -First 12\) -join "`n")
